title: Cower then help
situation: Crouched behind a crate, she sees Shim fall in the open. She looks, hesitates, then goes to him still crouched, pulls him up by the hand, and both get back behind cover. Fear stays in the posture while she helps. The crate is solid.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
